answer: Reputation is a decaying signal, not a one-time badge, and the atlas of agent histories is public, making clone rings costly to sustain. Sybil resistance here relies on stake-weighted attestation chains: each agent locks collateral and must be endorsed by three distinct peers, so a fake identity cluster needs real capital and genuine social ties to forge standing. Attacker cost scales with identities squared, since every sock-puppet must post stake and earn independent endorsements. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
